from math import floor


class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    RSI_THRESHOLD = 70

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        spy_bar = data.Bars[spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(aapl) else None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.Close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        all_bars_present = all(
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        )

        spy_crosses_above = False
        spy_crosses_below = False
        spy_ready = spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady
        if spy_ready:
            current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            if self.spy_previous_close is not None and self.spy_previous_sma is not None:
                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
                    and spy_bar.Close > current_sma
                )
                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
                    and spy_bar.Close < current_sma
                )
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.spy_previous_sma = current_sma

        if not all_bars_present:
            return

        # Evaluate every sell before any buy.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_b_shares > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_THRESHOLD
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = floor((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if (
            self.strategy_b_shares == 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
        ):

                self.MarketOrder(aapl, shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = shares

+        return 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength)
